##### Project general facts

Royalin Villas is an exclusive private retreat developed by DM Projects, an award-winning firm with over a decade of expertise in luxury villa design across Southeast Asia. This prestigious project blends traditional Moroccan aesthetics with modern amenities, featuring five or seven-bedroom villas, each with panoramic ocean views, a private gym, sauna, spa, swimming pool, and a rooftop jacuzzi. Every villa is built with an individual approach, reflecting the personality and desires of its future owner.

Residents enjoy an elevated lifestyle with a rooftop terrace featuring elegant sun loungers, a shaded pergola, and lush greenery. The villa includes a BBQ area, kids' playground, and a private chlorine-free salt filtration pool. Nearby, a commercial center offers an open restaurant with ocean views, coffee shop, healthy food store, beauty clinic, spa with Balinese rituals, nail bar, hair salon, brand shops, coworking space, and even a helicopter company office, creating a complete ecosystem of luxury and convenience.

Every Royalin villa tells a unique story, blending custom furniture, rare art, and exclusive materials curated by the founding architect-designer duo. The spacious living room is designed for comfort and elegance, while the kitchen features premium fixtures and appliances. Bedrooms offer serene sanctuaries with thoughtful layouts, and bathrooms showcase top-tier finishes. With end-to-end excellence from land acquisition to interiors, every detail reflects an uncompromising commitment to beauty, quality, and timeless luxury.

##### Parking
Shared parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in the prestigious Pandawa area, this exceptional location places residents just steps from Bali’s iconic Pandawa Beach, renowned for its pristine white sands and crystal-clear waters. The elevated position offers unobstructed panoramic ocean views, enhancing the property’s allure and providing a serene backdrop for daily living. The area is home to top attractions including the Bukit Pandawa Golf & Country Club, Timbis Flying Site, and stunning coastal cliffs.

The location is distinguished by its perfect balance of privacy and proximity. Residents enjoy easy access to world-class beaches, fine dining, golf courses, and cultural landmarks, all while being tucked away in a tranquil enclave. The nearby commercial center adds convenience, offering everything from gourmet restaurants to wellness clinics and boutique shopping.

For those seeking a residence that embodies coastal luxury, cultural richness, and strong investment potential, the Pandawa area delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of natural beauty, established infrastructure, and growing international demand makes it one of Bali’s most desirable addresses. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of Bal, serene, sophisticated and perfectly positioned
